title: Report decisions — five engagements
instructions: Each situation is independent and involves a private company. Select the most appropriate auditor's report.

exhibits.title: Situations
exhibits.content:
1. Management refuses to record depreciation on its main plant; the omission is material to net income and PP&E but doesn't affect other accounts.
2. The auditor was appointed after year-end and can't observe inventory or apply alternative procedures; inventory is 45% of total assets and drives cost of sales.
3. A major customer's bankruptcy is disclosed; the auditor believes it is fundamental to users' understanding. Everything else is fine.
4. Management won't disclose a going concern uncertainty that the auditor concluded exists; the omission is fundamental to understanding.
5. Substantial doubt exists and is adequately disclosed; plans aren't probable of implementation.

rows.label: 3. Customer bankruptcy disclosed
rows.explanation: An emphasis of an adequately disclosed matter.
